question: DAFgiving360 default acknowledgement: read the 2026 Program Policies and the 'how to recommend a grant' help page (dafgiving360.org robots.txt returned 403 on 2026-11-19) through a robots-permitted mirror or a sponsor-published PDF, and record which of the three letter options is preselected
conclusion_affected: Asset-weighted default shares (DAFgiving360 is 16.3% of top-20 assets and alone moves the full-contact share between 33% and 50%)
rationale: The 2024 Program Policies list three options with no default; every other national above $20bn now has a public default, so DAFgiving360 is the largest unknown

question: Ren platform default by private label: collect public DonorFirst/DFX donor guides for every Ren-administered program (RCF, MS GIFT, BofA CGF, Raymond James if Ren-hosted, T. Rowe Price, UBS, LPL, Ameriprise) and record the acknowledgement default each shows; test whether the default is a Ren platform setting or a sponsor choice
conclusion_affected: Whether defaults are vendor-driven (EDF origin network: technical) or sponsor-driven (organizational)
rationale: Two Ren portal guides from 2025-26 differ: BofA's DonorFirst guide says 'The default is Fund Name Only'; RCF's DFX guide says the default 'includes the grant advisor's name, email, and address'

question: Observed disclosure outcomes by sponsor: collect published shares of grants sent with full contact, fund name only and anonymous (Fidelity 2026 Giving Report: 80/15/5 in 2025; Vanguard 4% or 5% anonymous; NPT and others) and compare with each sponsor's default to estimate how often donors leave the default unchanged
conclusion_affected: Synthesis E (identity data); Clarity G12-2 'reconsider if opt-in rates under consent prompts fall below the full-contact default share'
rationale: Only Fidelity publishes a breakdown by disclosure level; with a full-contact default 80% of its grants carry name and address. No sponsor with a fund-name default publishes the same split

question: Bank of America CGF internal conflict: reconcile the 2024 Program Guidelines ('Distributions are accompanied by information specifying the account name and the name of the Donor or Advisor, unless anonymity is requested') with the 2025-26 portal guide ('The default is Fund Name Only'), using any newer Program Guidelines PDF on bankofamerica.com
conclusion_affected: BofA default bucket (fund name only vs name only); 1.9% of top-20 assets
rationale: Two sponsor documents disagree; the portal guide was used as the current default

question: Donor email to charity: for the 20 sponsors, record whether the donor's email address can be passed to the charity at all (RCF default; CJP and GKCCF on donor choice; Fidelity, NPT, Vanguard, NCF, FFTC, ImpactAssets and JCF documents mention only mailing address) and through which rail (letter, EFT report, PayPal, DAFpay)
conclusion_affected: Data-standards finding that no shared donor-disclosure field exists; entrant consent-field design
rationale: Most sponsor documents name postal address only; email (the channel nonprofits use to thank) is documented as a default only at RCF
